name: Proxmox_VE_Subscription
description: Proxmox subscription status and renewal date for every online node.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript, one /nodes/{node}/subscription call per online node per interval. O(nodes). The endpoint needs no privilege beyond authentication.

nextduedate is a YYYY-MM-DD string rather than an epoch, so it is parsed as UTC midnight. A node with no subscription has no due date at all and reports none -- zero days remaining would read as 'expires today' on every unlicensed node.

Active ships without a threshold: an unsubscribed node is a licensing fact, not a fault, and a homelab would alert forever. Set a threshold where a subscription is genuinely expected.

datapoints.name: Active
datapoints.description: 1 when the node reports an active subscription. Ships without a threshold: an unsubscribed node is a licensing fact, not a fault.

datapoints.name: Sockets
datapoints.description: CPU sockets the subscription key covers.

datapoints.name: DaysUntilDue
datapoints.description: Days until the subscription's next due date. Withheld on a node with no subscription rather than reported as zero.
datapoints.alertBody: The Proxmox subscription on node ##INSTANCE## is due in ##VALUE## days. If it lapses, the node loses access to the enterprise repository and its updates.

datapoints.name: DaysSinceLastCheck
datapoints.description: Days since Proxmox last validated the key against the subscription server.
